sio2_melting_2_subtask_structure_retriev.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Melting - Level 2
sio2_melting_2_subtask_structure_retriev.description: Retrieve structure of SiO2 and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

sio2_melting_2_subtask_potential_file.name: SiO2 Potential File for Melting - Level 2
sio2_melting_2_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Tersoff potential file for SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

sio2_melting_2_subtask_melting.name: SiO2 NPT Melting - Level 2
sio2_melting_2_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible SiO2 structure file and Tersoff potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the melting of the system by heating it under NPT. Monitor the Si–O bond length using the partial radial distribution function (RDF) throughout the heating. Identify the phase change where the first RDF peak shows a significant change, defined as more than 10% increase from the initial value. Report the final average Si–O bond length in the molten state in Å.
